name: @hhmi/proofig-pdf-service-cloudrun
description: Bundled Proofig PDF service (Cloud Run deployment shell)

scripts.build:service: cd ../../packages/proofig-pdf-service && bun run build && cd ../.. && cp packages/proofig-pdf-service/dist/index.js services/proofig-pdf-cloudrun/ && mkdir -p services/proofig-pdf-cloudrun/native && rm -f services/proofig-pdf-cloudrun/native/*.node && touch services/proofig-pdf-cloudrun/native/.keep && (cp packages/proofig-pdf-service/dist/*.node services/proofig-pdf-cloudrun/native/ 2>/dev/null || true) && cd services/proofig-pdf-cloudrun
scripts.build:local: bun run build:service && docker build --tag proofig-pdf-local .
